QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_55

question.text: Which of the following is a mandatory characteristic of non-SEBI regulated activities that a merchant banker may carry out through SBUs?

answer.text: They must be fund-based and revenue-generating
They must be in the manufacturing sector
They must generate at least 50% of the MB's revenue
They must be fee-based, non-fund-based, and in the financial services sector

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the relevant non-SEBI regulated activities permitted through SBUs must be fee-based, non-fund based, and must pertain to the financial services sector. All three characteristics must be satisfied together. The Trap: "Fund-based" is the exact opposite of what is permitted under this rule. The manufacturing sector and the 50% revenue threshold are not part of the workbook test. Note: The three conditions are cumulative — fee-based, non-fund based, and within the financial services sector — and apply to the SBU activity itself.
